title: GOOSE exact-size frame with tagged APDU fields
purpose: Provide a complete GOOSE Ethernet frame preserving the documented exact-size relation while also including realistic APDU field tags for better semantic coverage.
expected_behavior: A GOOSE parser should classify the frame by EtherType 0x88b8, observe the exact size relation, and then process the outer APDU tag 0x61 with multiple documented field tags including allData.
constraints_preserved: GOOSE length field is 0x0061 and total frame length is exactly 14 plus 97 bytes.
GOOSE APDU outer tag is documented 0x61.
Included field tags are documented: 0x80 gocbRef, 0x85 stNum, 0x86 sqNum, 0x88 confRev, 0x8a numDatSetEntries, 0xab allData.
All BER lengths are internally consistent and no trailing padding is added.
issue_safety_notes: This keeps the issue-guided exact-size acceptance relation but replaces filler-only content with a safer tagged APDU and does not reuse any known PoC bytes.
